descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S17 Day boundaries, seeded: a new-day write that resends yesterday's lines lists none twice; a diverging resend and late-evening row dates are recorded (both modes)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U11 Nothing invented or doubled: the list holds only lines that were recorded or dictated, with no added line (e.g. 'Encounter completed.') and no line listed twice. (UAT 3.4)
  • U9 Time-based rules (what counts as today and yesterday, when a transcript becomes a prior entry, when it leaves) use the server clock. … (UAT 3.8)
  • T2 Collapsed rows are labelled accurately (e.g. 'Most Recent'), so each row says which encounter it is. (TFA-92594 AC 3; TFA-92594 How it works 3)
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, and passes in both. (UAT 3.3; TFA-92594 AC 2)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given (a) {hospitalPatient}: rounding.update transcriptDate D-1 [M1, M2], then transcriptDate D [M1, M2, M3] — the write a tab left open over midnight sends without the client fix. (a2) {hospitalPatient2}: D-1 [A, B], then D [A, B', C], where B' differs from B only in its time string. …

When Open the Hospital list (lifecycle runs), patient 1's Encounter tab and its '(prior)' row; patient 2's Encounter tab; switch to Nursing Home and open the resident's Encounter tab

Then (a) '<D-1> (prior)' holds M1 and M2 once, and 'Most Recent' holds only M3. (a2) Whether A and B are listed in both rows is recorded. (c) The rotated rows' dates are recorded against the physician's Eastern day and the UTC day

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U11 (no line listed twice; the e61d872 regression), from UAT 3.4. cp1 (patient 1, collapsed): mustContain '{Mon D, D-1} (prior)', '2 lines', 'Most Recent'; mustNotContain '3 lines' (Most Recent doubled to M1-M3; no other row on this chart has three lines, and '3 lines' is not a substring of '1 lines' or '2 lines'). cp2 (prior row open): mustContain QA16-MID-1, QA16-MID-2. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S17 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-16.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
